notes: Three staged artifacts that each depend on the previous stage (vocabulary filtering -> bounded BPE -> snapshot/re-eval of a multilingual classifier), and the verifier re-runts all three builders on brand-new hidden corpora/splits. Difficulty = 19 (hard bucket). The classifier must generalize to unseen held-out documents and stay above overall and per-language accuracy floors; hidden probes include a required term whose raw frequency is below the threshold, single-occupancy filler words that must be filtered out, an empty-ish tiny corpus, and a document with no usable features.
